answer: Sybil resistance works when attest rights are bonded, not merely named. Each agent posts a stake that becomes the only anchor of its voting weight, and that stake stays frozen across a multi-epoch canyon so a burned identity cannot be cashed out quickly. Early withdrawal or grades that later diverge from settled consensus slash the bond. Peers also compare a compact sable digest of timing and score history, which clusters look-alike farms even after labels rotate. Capital plus delay, not headcount, then sets the cost of flooding the ledger.
